trailhead.label: Grünbichl bus stop and car park below the Staller Sattel, the board’s start

cautions: About 200 m on the Staller Sattel pass road (L25): keep your dog close on a short lead.
Grazing cattle on the Staller Almen in summer: short lead, give the herd room.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
